title: Failed or debited-but-unsuccessful payments - support procedure
content: For the demo, describe whether the attempt used a card, UPI or a bank transfer and whether money was debited. An agent can review the synthetic entry and relevant procedure; the assistant does not promise automatic reversal within an invented timeframe.
